For a 50-person Indian company, switching difficulty depends more on implementation and support model than headline pricing. Public enterprise pricing is mostly quote-based, so treat fees below as commercial terms to negotiate, not published tariffs.

Provider	Cost model	Switching difficulty
MakeMyTrip myBiz	Custom service fee; potentially 1.5% payment-gateway fee in some payment flows	Low — self-serve setup, employee upload, policies and dashboard; migration can be relatively quick. 
MakeMyTrip
+1

Thomas Cook India Corporate Travel	Quote-based TMC/transaction pricing	Medium–High — implementation, approval workflows, reporting and dedicated servicing create more migration work, but it supports end-to-end travel. 
Thomas Cook

FCM Travel India	Bespoke enterprise programme/transaction pricing	High — more programme configuration and integration, but broader managed-service capabilities and 24/7 assistance. 
FCM Travel
+1

Practical switching cost: budget 1–4 weeks for a 50-person migration, mainly for employee data, travel-policy configuration, payment/GST setup, approvals and traveller onboarding.

For a smaller company, the key negotiation point is zero/low implementation fee + no lock-in + export of traveller/booking data on exit.

For a modern rose fragrance under ₹6,000 in India, these three are currently purchasable:

Fragrance	Current price / reviews	Support & returns	Warranty/cancellation
L’Atelier Parfum Rose Coup De Foudre 15ml	₹1,600; 4.6/5, 2,362 international reviews	Sephora India customer care; third-party delivery	Cancellation/return subject to Sephora India terms; fragrance is an exclusive. 
Sephora India

Forest Essentials Gulnar Rose & Carnation	~₹1,750; 4.3/5, 108 verified Nykaa ratings	Nykaa support; verified-buyer reviews praise its distinctive rose character, though longevity feedback varies	Nykaa allows eligible returns within 15 days, with original packaging/seals; cancellation before shipment. 
Nykaa
+1

Solinotes Rose EDP 50ml	₹2,520; 3/5 (2 ratings)	Nykaa support; 100% genuine listing	15-day return/replacement only for eligible unused/defective/damaged/wrong items; cancellation before shipment. 
Nykaaman
+1

Practical distinction: L’Atelier is a cooler, woody-musky modern rose; Forest Essentials is richer and more traditional-luxury; Solinotes is the simplest budget experiment. None offers a conventional perfume “warranty”; protection is primarily retailer return/replacement policy.
